title: How long ago did each begin?
prompt: Place each one by how long ago it first appeared.

items.label: The first smartphone era
items.fact: The original iPhone launched in 2007 and reset what a phone could be.

items.label: The World Wide Web
items.fact: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the Web in 1989 at CERN.

items.label: The United States
items.fact: A young country by world standards — founded in 1776.

items.label: The Great Pyramid of Giza
items.fact: It was already ancient when Cleopatra was alive.

items.label: The first dinosaurs
items.fact: Dinosaurs ruled for over 150 million years before their extinction.

items.label: Planet Earth
items.fact: Roughly a third of the age of the universe itself.
